## Design

### 2026-10-11 – I started by building a schematic for my starbie. It was my first one, so it took me a minute to understand what I was doing, but I just had to drag out components, place them, and connect them.

**10h**

I started by building a schematic for my starbie. It was my first one, so it took me a minute to understand what I was doing, but I just had to drag out components, place them, and connect them.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/CKgJHytMaNCHYkOsQBHmXLQkfNl69TFO/50bd6341074e0fcdcba526755af24a4dc8493fe55d860b844a26606021301534.png)

After the schematic, I added footprints to each component to identify them all more easily.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/CKgJHytMaNCHYkOsQBHmXLQkfNl69TFO/54837694327527eed7ccb5ff7e2ecd47300b0ec851e1d76b614f2d09e8b95f02.png)

Next, I built the actual PCB by making the shape for the PCB, then I organized the components inside the star, and then I connected the power wires. Next, I filled the rest of it with a GND layer. Lastly, I used the base code and then added some changes

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/CKgJHytMaNCHYkOsQBHmXLQkfNl69TFO/f9a23d324d458117c15c55d4cda5b0e48b5e0a34e0f82045a24e25ec7ea47295.png)
